snippet.title: What Happens When You Eat Too Fast
snippet.description:
What happens when you eat too fast? You swallow air with your food, so your stomach bloats, and your brain can take fifteen minutes or more to notice that you are full, so you keep eating. This cartoon shows it from inside the stomach, and Dr. Mira shares the simple fix from the US National Institutes of Health: eat slowly, chew well, and put your fork down.

Sources:
• NIH National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. Symptoms and Causes of Gas in the Digestive Tract (last reviewed June 2021): https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/gas-digestive-tract/symptoms-causes
• NIH National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. Food Portions: Choosing Just Enough for You (last reviewed July 2021): https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/weight-management/just-enough-food-portions
